list.title: My Agents
list.subtitle: Manage installed agent instances
list.empty: Choose an agent to use on this computer. Existing installations are reused, and you can connect the agent to a workspace when you’re ready.
list.alsoRemovedFromWorkspace: Its membership in {{workspace}} is removed as well — otherwise it would stay there as a member $t(common.appName) can no longer reach.

toast.notConnectedYet: {{name}} hasn't joined a workspace yet — click Join workspace first.

error.title: Last error from {{name}}
error.hint: This is what the daemon reported when the agent last failed. It is cleared once the agent starts cleanly.

list.emptyNoFilterMatch: Every agent you have is in another state right now.

toast.invalidName: Agent name can only contain letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores
toast.selectFolder: Choose a working folder for the agent

workdir.label: Working directory
workdir.hint: Where this agent runs. A change applies the next time the agent starts.

connectDialog.title: Add '{{name}}' to a workspace
connectDialog.keyboardHint: Use ↑ ↓ to select, Enter to join.
connectDialog.emptyTitle: This device isn't in any workspace yet
connectDialog.emptyBody: Connect one from the command line with `agn connect`, then come back and pick it here. This device can belong to several workspaces at once.

shared.localDescription: Available for local use. No account required.
shared.deviceSettingsHint: Manage this device’s connections and installed software.
shared.overviewSubtitle: Your device, workspace connections, and the agents running here.
shared.folderHint: Defaults to your home folder. Choose a project folder for this agent’s work.

renameDialog.title: Rename {{name}}
renameDialog.description: This changes the label shown here and in the agent's workspace. Its identity is unchanged, so sessions, working directory and workspace membership all stay as they are.
renameDialog.label: Display name
renameDialog.hint: Leave empty to go back to {{name}}.
